title: 潮间倒影

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮登记：人物单脚系于相连海边花树枝并平静倒悬，潮池中保留对应倒影，树干与岩岸完整。未做审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Hanged Man, theme 潮间倒影 / Tidal Reflection. Use attached original only as identity and refined painterly style reference: exactly ONE calm dark-haired person hangs safely HEAD DOWN, ONE ankle clearly tied with a visible rope to a thick flowering seaside tree branch, the other leg bent. The branch crosses the upper edge and remains visibly connected to a complete sturdy trunk, never floating or broken. Place the figure slightly LEFT, leaving a broad tidal pool below; the pool contains ONE physically plausible aligned reflection of the same figure and branch, no second real person. Palette cyan blue, coral pink blossoms, white and deep violet cloth, natural skin. Show serene expression, anatomically coherent hands, both legs and clear rope knot. Solid rock shoreline anchors tree and pool to bottom bleed. Fine celestial gold tarot border, rich hand-painted fantasy atmosphere. No extra person, no severed branch, no typography, title, letters, numbers, watermark or logo. One complete opaque image.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.

productionDetail.composition: 花枝横过上缘，人物倒悬偏左，下方潮池保留倒影空间
productionDetail.supportGeometry: 整段系绳花枝与树干相连，潮池反射锁定地面
productionDetail.connectedGroup: 人物、脚绳、连接枝整体；倒影与水面一组，需要随观察正确对应，否则关闭主体额外视差；本主题支撑归属：整段系绳花枝与树干相连，潮池反射锁定地面

productionDetail.specificQA: 只一人且单脚绳不接颈；另一腿弯曲，双手在头后；反射无法对齐时主体与水面同组或关闭额外视差
productionDetail.samplePrinciple: 借鉴五样本的完整承接、真实透明、主题材质和极端倾斜复核，不按槽位强行套题材。
